retrievalProfile.description: A minimalist layout featuring two overlapping, stylized line-art faces in contrasting primary colors with a clean, off-white background and structured serif typography.
excludeWhen: dark or textured backgrounds are requested
sans-serif modernism is the primary goal

recipe.visualDefinition: A central graphic composed of two simplified, continuous-line facial profiles in red and blue that overlap to create a purple intersection, set against a cream background with a right-aligned list of names and centered header text.
coreVisualRelationships: Overlapping primary colors creating secondary color intersections
Central abstract graphic vs. right-aligned text block
Clean negative space framing the central illustration
Hierarchical serif typography ranging from large display to small list text
coreInvariants: Transparent color blending at the intersection of the two faces

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The overlapping faces are centered horizontally but slightly offset to the left to balance the right-aligned text.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central purple intersection where the two faces meet.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large top header, moves down to the central graphic, and then scans the vertical list on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive cream-colored negative space provides a clean, sophisticated feel.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Red and Blue for the line art
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation for the primary colors against a low-saturation, high-value background.

letterConstructionRules: High contrast between thick and thin strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Roman All-Caps for titles paired with Italic Title Case for lists.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule under the main title
Transparency/Multiply blending mode for the central illustration

candidateDirections.reason: Classic serif with elegant italics suitable for the list.
High contrast and sharp serifs match the display style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cream-colored background with two overlapping line-art faces in the center. One face should be red, the other blue, with a purple intersection where they overlap. Leave the right third of the image empty for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a centered all-caps serif title at the top with a thin horizontal line below it. Add a right-aligned list of names in an italic serif font down the right side.

verificationChecks: Is the background a flat cream color?
Do the red and blue lines create a purple color where they cross?
Is the list of names strictly right-aligned?
Is the main title in all-caps serif?

adjustableVariables: Alignment of the text list (left vs right)
mustRedesign: Do not use specific artist names or logos
Do not use the exact facial features from the original art
Ensure the line art is a new interpretation of the 'two rooms' concept
postGenerationChecks: Check for color transparency at the line intersection
Verify the serif font has high stroke contrast
Ensure the right-aligned text does not overlap the central graphic
Confirm the background is a solid, non-textured color
recipe.reuseFormula: Minimalist Line Art + Overlapping Primary Colors + Structured Serif Typography
